disciplines.name: Ground clearing
disciplines.description: Remove vegetation before ground construction begins.

disciplines.name: Excavation
disciplines.description: Dig soil to the required depth.

disciplines.name: Fill grading
disciplines.description: Sort and place earth used as fill.

disciplines.name: Rammed earth
disciplines.description: Compact damp earth inside temporary forms.

disciplines.name: Embankments
disciplines.description: Raise broad banks from layered soil.

disciplines.name: Ditch cutting
disciplines.description: Excavate long trenches through suitable ground.

disciplines.name: Slope terracing
disciplines.description: Cut level working platforms into hillsides.

disciplines.name: Compaction
disciplines.description: Compress placed earth to reduce later sinking.

disciplines.name: Earth dams
disciplines.description: Build water barriers primarily from compacted soil.

disciplines.name: Foundation drainage
disciplines.description: Keep water away from building footings.

disciplines.name: Retaining banks
disciplines.description: Shape banks that support adjacent earth.

disciplines.name: Settlement watching
disciplines.description: Watch new fill for sinking and cracks.

disciplines.name: Earthwork repair
disciplines.description: Restore eroded banks and damaged earth structures.

disciplines.name: Earthwork surveys
disciplines.description: Measure terrain before large soil-moving works.
